headline: RBNZ Governor Notes Persistent Inflation and Uneven Economic Recovery
summary: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Governor Dr. Anna Breman stated that inflation remains above the 2% target mid-point, while the country's economic recovery remains uneven.
why: Central bank commentary provides essential insights into future monetary policy, which directly impacts interest rates, currency values, and economic growth projections for the nation.

impacts.name: New Zealand Official Cash Rate
impacts.why: Central bank commentary on inflation and growth influences market expectations for future interest rate adjustments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Statements regarding inflation targets and economic health influence market expectations for interest rate paths, affecting the currency and bond yields.
